newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria Expressbank 96 net profit 1.4 bln lev.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria Expressbank 96 net profit 1.4 bln lev.

text.p: Bulgaria's state-owned Expressbank posted 1.377 billion lev net profit for 1996 after a gross profit of 289.1 million levs in 1995, which was fully set aside as provisions, the bank's chief executive director said on Monday.

"Expressbank had a net profit of 1.377 billion levs for last year and the shareholders decided to back it fully into the bank's reserves," Ivan Konstantinov told Reuters after a general shareholders' meeting.
Expressbank gross profit for 1996 totalled 27.404 billion levs, of which 25.148 billion levs were set aside as provisions and taxes of 878.677 million levs were paid.
After backing last year's net into reserves, the bank's capital totalled 5.462 billion levs, including equity capital of 3.566 billion levs.
Bulgaria's Bank Consolidation Company (BCC), which manages state equity in local commercial banks holds some 98 percent of the capital of the Varna-based bank.

Last year Expressbank capital was boosted by the BCC through dollar-denominated bonds worth $15 million as part of a government scheme to support seven state banks with government paper worth of $400 million.
Expressbank assets amounted to some 100 billion levs and it is among state banks earmarked for privatisation by the end of this year.
So far Austria's Raiffeisenbank, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) and South Korea's Daewoo Corp . had shown interests in buying stakes in Expressbank, a BCC official said.
The EBRD was expected to enter a privatisation deal as a co-investor, the BCC official added.

Konstaninov declined to comment about the potential buyers, saying that negotiations were subject to approval by the BCC as the main shareholder. ($=1,570 Bulgarian levs) -- Sofia Newsroom, (+359-2) 911 88
